headline: Master Peyton Survives the Opening Shootout
dek: Week 1 finally produced receipts: No. 1 Master Peyton held off The Duke 160.16–153.22, 28Wizardking escaped the league’s closest finish, and the first live power board rewarded two risers.

lead.title: Master Peyton Takes the First Punch and Keeps the Crown
lead.body: The EFL’s first completed week delivered a heavyweight opener at the top of the scoring table. Master Peyton posted a league-best 160.16 points and survived The Duke 160.16–153.22, a 6.94-point margin in the week’s highest-scoring matchup at 313.38 combined points. The Duke’s 153.22 was the second-highest total in the league but still produced an 0-1 start, while Kaaron Rodgers scored 142.14 in a 61.78-point win over KamaraVirus125177 and The Don’s Soldiers opened with 133.36 in a win over LandsharkSC. Across all 12 franchises, Week 1 scoring averaged 119.68 points. The refreshed EFL power board keeps Master Peyton No. 1 at 88.4, with The Don’s Soldiers No. 2 and Kaaron Rodgers No. 3; The Duke rises to No. 5 despite the loss after its 153.22-point showing.

briefs.label: PHOTO FINISH
briefs.title: 28Wizardking Escapes by 2.14
briefs.body: The closest result of Week 1 belonged to 28Wizardking, which edged bonebuster 106.80–104.66. The 2.14-point margin was the only EFL matchup decided by fewer than seven points outside the Master Peyton–The Duke shootout.

briefs.label: POWER BOARD
briefs.title: The Duke and Landshark Move Up
briefs.body: The first post-Week 1 ranking refresh keeps the top four intact: Master Peyton, The Don’s Soldiers, Kaaron Rodgers and Blaze Infantry. The Duke climbs one spot to No. 5 and LandsharkSC rises to No. 9, while Trash Pandas slips to No. 6 and 28Wizardking falls to No. 10. The model movement is separate from the 1-0 and 0-1 standings.

briefs.label: SCORING DESK
briefs.title: Four Franchises Clear 130 in the Opener
briefs.body: Master Peyton (160.16), The Duke (153.22), Kaaron Rodgers (142.14) and The Don’s Soldiers (133.36) formed the opening week’s top scoring tier. The league averaged 119.68 points per franchise, with an 80.36-to-160.16 range between the week’s lowest and highest totals.

briefs.label: TRANSACTION WIRE
briefs.title: Waivers Move; the Trade Desk Stays Quiet
briefs.body: Sleeper shows no completed trade in the closing Week 1 window from September 8 through September 11. The Duke spent $18 FAAB to add Michael Mayer, Mach Chicken added Jauan Jennings and Darnell Washington for $0 bids, and The Don’s Soldiers added Emari Demercado for $0 while dropping Roschon Johnson. The last completed trade in Sleeper’s Week 1 bucket remains the August 30 Duke–Blaze deal that sent Dalton Kincaid to The Duke and DK Metcalf to Blaze Infantry, with 2028 second- and third-round picks also changing hands.
